scope: Reviewed host policy, pinned modal reader and bounded state-driven policy self-Cure; no public-runner recovery acceptance

criteria.expected: Engine-backed item counts, ability MP costs and legal targets as required by concrete rules
criteria.observed: Effective MP cost decoded and compared to 2,429 executed retail-function cases. White Magic menu row identity and enable gate observed live, including insufficient MP rejection. Item counts and general legal ally/KO targets remain unproven.

criteria.expected: Heal under threshold, revive before attack, MP reserve, never use items by default
criteria.observed: Schema v2 and healer preset implement host selection: Life on KO ally, Cure on living wounded ally/self, eight-MP reserve on all casts, consumables disabled. Regression rejects unrelated ally abilities and Cure on KO. Constructed-fixture self-Cure heals 100 to 156/163 HP and consumes six MP in two runs, but the policy chooser does not drive either run. Later state-driven research runs a6-policy-cure-03/-04 choose heal-self and consume MP85->79, HP100->166; MP6 reserve decline and MP5 refusal preserve resources. Public recovery remains open.

criteria.expected: Threshold boundaries, zero max HP, KO vs living, insufficient MP, missing revive and last consumable
criteria.observed: 119/119 policy checks; seven mutation controls rejected with an unmutated isolated positive control. Broad rules prove disabled-items and empty-count rejection independently of item predicates.

criteria.expected: Compare healer and damage-focused policies on a wounded party; prove executed recovery, consumed resource and fallback when unavailable
criteria.observed: Not run. Ability candidate availability, legal target and engine execution are prerequisites; synthetic candidates cannot establish this criterion.

criteria.expected: One accepted self-Cure with selected ability identity, returned actor and HP/MP effect
criteria.observed: a6-cure-cast-03: Cure ID 1; unit and peer 02000080; self cursor (4,10); HP100->163, MP85->79 in both canonical member and restored battle mirror. Command list restored, Action disabled. Earlier cast-02 HP100->156 and MP85->79. Disposable job/HP/MP edits precede research input; not policy acceptance.

criteria.expected: Cure disabled and rejected below six MP with no resource effect
criteria.observed: Five-MP run: first White Magic row enable=0; confirmation stays in list and does not latch Cure; final HP100 MP5 unchanged. Pre-preview HUD retains stale 388/85 after fixture edits.

criteria.expected: Reader matches the decoded retail function including support effects and rounding
criteria.observed: 2,429 engine comparisons across all 347 ability IDs, six support/race profiles and null unit; seven invalid fact controls rejected. Constructed-unit ROM execution, not live availability.

criteria.expected: Policy-selected recovery with verified modal actor/target, stop/cancel handling and resource fallback
criteria.observed: Bounded research executor now selects self-Cure through the healer policy, proves reserve/low-MP cancellation and prompt STOP. Public runner still Move/Wait; safe Wait/facing fallback, full turn completion and public integration remain UNKNOWN.

criteria.expected: At six MP Cure opens, then cancellation consumes no HP/MP
criteria.observed: a6-cure-cancel-01: Cure enabled at MP6; self preview opens; B/B returns to Action group, HP100 MP6 unchanged. This does not establish safe identity restoration.

criteria.expected: Independent canonical actor and active UI/target ownership during borrowed roster, with stale/drift rejection
criteria.observed: 14 retained captured states plus one labeled derived settling state; 46 rejection controls. Driver wrapper and active target processor distinguish returned overlay from cached finished description. No ActorAdapter guard is relaxed.

criteria.expected: Two constructed-fixture state-driven self-Cure reloads selected by exact healer policy; one final confirmation, exact resource cost, restored mirror
criteria.observed: a6-policy-cure-03/-04: heal-self, HP100->166 MP85->79, Action disabled, restored mirror agrees; inspected confirmation/result screenshots. Narrow action acceptance only; no turn completion/public runner claim.

criteria.expected: Enabled Cure declined at MP reserve boundary; unavailable Cure not selected; no HP/MP consumption
criteria.observed: a6-policy-reserve-03: MP6 available but policy declines eight-MP reserve; cancellation returns to command with HP100/MP6. low-mp-01: MP5 disabled Cure skipped, command returned HP100/MP5. Fallback unexecuted; normal roster still scratch after reserve cancellation.

criteria.expected: Live STOP at final prompt suppresses final confirmation and further gameplay writes
criteria.observed: a6-policy-stop-01 paused at Do it/Cancel: 8 keys/40 raw writes; no ninth confirmation; zero writes after observed STOP. Owned process cleaned up. This is not leave-running/manual-handoff acceptance.

review_findings: Healer rules matched any ally ability; corrected to named Life/Cure and living-target Cure.
Life bypassed the eight-MP reserve; reserve now applies to revive too.
Enabled kind:item alone bypassed configuration opt-in rejection; now rejected.
Mutation subprocesses lacked preset paths; repaired with absolute --configs and an unmutated positive control. Two previously surviving mutants now fail on broad-rule controls.
A5 threshold-30 live boundary was 84/241 HP, not 177/241; corrected A5 receipt and docs. Future policy turn receipts carry the actual chooser snapshot.
pause-at-boundary test expected a wall-clock frame on an immediate pump; retained failure, then corrected observation window passes without runtime changes.
next_dependency: Implement and validate a separate targeting/confirmation modal reader that pins actor, canonical unit/peer, ability and state; cancellation and stale/changed target controls precede policy integration, ally/KO targeting and wounded-party replay. DE-033 full cancellation remains scratch even at command mode 4; neither cursor nor cached ability is a safe fresh-state signal.
